retained_rows.assessment_basis: The workflow produced material AI-assisted adjudication decisions intended for a shared durable Git record, so context-appropriate process/decision traceability is directly relevant. The preserved recovery view states that most completed role-aware adjudication had not reached GitHub before context termination; the failure screenshot records termination, and direct Git history confirms the earlier two-Incident checkpoint. Those completed decisions were unavailable for continuation and required reconstruction. This establishes a bounded traceability failure for that missing material decision state, independently of the taxonomy finding; later reconstructed blobs do not measure how much was lost and no hidden architecture claim is made.
retained_rows.identification_basis: Occurrence evidence directly concerns missing traceability of completed AI-assisted analytical decisions at a durable-workflow boundary; the OECD process/decision traceability proposition is independently identified.

external_requirements.coverage_disposition: Independent repair, traceability, restriction and reliability results remain confined to their distinct evidence objects.
